name: Zero-Cloud PII & Secret Stream Scrubber
description: Deterministically redacts emails, IPv4 addresses, SSNs, Luhn-valid card numbers, API keys, and phone numbers in real-time streams.
author: morph-os-core
llm_prompt: Scrub all personally identifiable information (emails, SSNs, IPv4s, cards, bearer tokens) replacing them with [REDACTED:<TYPE>] placeholders. Output ONLY JSON with keys 'scrubbed' and 'redacted_total'.
sample_input: 2026-11-25T14:02:11Z INFO auth_worker user=ops.admin@example.org ip=10.42.8.19 ssn=123-45-6789 phone=415-555-0199 auth="Bearer morph_demo_token_998877665544"
